name: Player third-person camera
notes: Starting numbers from mw-e02.4. FOV 70° (the bead's default). The pivot sits at head height (1.5 m of the 1.8 m capsule) and 0.5 m over the right shoulder, so the character reads left of centre and the path ahead stays clear. Zoom 2–6 m in 0.5 m wheel notches, starting at 3.5 m (the mw-e02.23 follow distance). Pitch −70°..+60° as the bead specifies, starting 15° down on the player. Mouse sensitivity 0.003 rad per count keeps the mw-e02.23 feel. The stick block is the gamepad's rate-based right-stick look (mw-e02.9): 15% radial deadzone, squared response for fine aim, 240°/s turn and 160°/s pitch at full deflection (a typical third-person action default). Collision radius 0.26 m keeps the camera 0.26 m from walls (AC-2 asks ≥ 0.2) and holds the whole 0.1 m near plane at 70° (0.243 m reach) in a 16:9 window; wider windows grow it at run time. Recovery 0.3 s with an ease-out, as AC-3 specifies; pulling in is instant so no frame clips.
